notes: Ruka 0.5.5: TUF-style update metadata, differential updates, signed kill switch, local FCC detection, multi-file mutation testing and replay fuzzy matching. Update metadata is verified through root -> timestamp -> snapshot -> targets -> latest.json with a pinned root key and expiry checks. The updater reuses unchanged blocks from a cached previous installer; rebuilding 0.5.4 from 0.5.3 downloaded 6.1 MB instead of 176.8 MB (96.6% reused) and matched the published SHA-256. Settings shows a blocked version from rollout.killed. Models can detect a local FCC proxy, show its version and latency, and fill the base URL and first model. Mutation checks run up to three mutants across changed files. Replay tolerates near-identical prompts, model tags and tool arguments with a warning and stops on divergence.
